title: Exponentially Many Circuit Double Covers
summary: The cycle double cover conjecture of Szekeres and Seymour, the proof of which was recently announced by OpenAI, states that every bridgeless graph has a collection of cycles covering every edge exactly twice. We study the counting version of this statement for cubic graphs, where we count circuit double covers --- collections of circuits (connected 2-regular subgraphs) covering every edge twice.
